title: Step 9 unpauses both stakers BEFORE the YS-22 pauser-recorded require; under the documented --skip-simulation a missing pauser key leaves the live staker unpaused but its pauser un-restored
rootCause: Validate-after-mutate ordering: unpause() on both stakers executes (lines 357-368) BEFORE the YS-22 pauser-recorded require (lines 371-385). Under the documented --skip-simulation flag, a later revert lands AFTER the unpause txs are already broadcast.
impact: No fund loss. Narrow operator-error window: with a missing pauser key (realistically a hand-edited JSON), the live staker is reopened to users (unpaused) while its pauser is left on a stale/unintended value, until a corrective re-run.
attackPath: 1. Operator runs step 9 with the documented --skip-simulation flag.
2. A pauser key is missing (realistically a hand-edited JSON).
3. unpause() on both stakers broadcasts first (lines 357-368).
4. The YS-22 pauser-recorded require reverts (lines 371-385) — but AFTER the unpause txs already landed.
5. Live staker is unpaused with its pauser not restored until a corrective re-run.
recommendation: Move the YS-22 pauser-recorded requires ABOVE the unpause() calls (validate-then-mutate), or drop --skip-simulation so a revert rolls back the whole run.
severityRationale: Low: bounded operator-error window with no fund loss and a hard-revert that forces eventual correction; conditional on a flag plus a hand-edited JSON. C4 operational-ordering / state-handling -> Low. Distinct from ledger YS-22/10fac478 (pauser-restore catch-path) and YS-24/ba886105 (tempPauser zero-gate).
footgunRationale: Non-obvious ordering footgun: validate-after-mutate under the documented flag. Safe-config: validate-then-mutate, or drop --skip-simulation.
threeLawFraming: Law 3 in-scope non-obvious footgun; Law 1 honest severity Low (no fund loss, fail-loud on re-run).
relatedNote: Same cleanup script as ledger YS-22/10fac478 and YS-24/ba886105 but distinct root cause/region (validate-after-mutate ordering).
